title: Odd Perfect Number Problem
status: Open · no odd perfect number is known
statusZh: 开放 · 尚未发现奇完全数
author: Classical problem

overview.summary: Does an odd positive integer equal the sum of its proper divisors? OPBench asks for the integer together with a complete prime-power factorization, making every finite claim checkable.
overview.summaryZh: 是否存在等于其真因数之和的奇正整数？OPBench 要求同时提交完整素数幂分解，使每项有限断言都可核验。

visualization.label: Divisor mass must balance exactly
visualization.labelZh: 约数总和必须精确平衡
visualization.caption: Six is even and perfect. The benchmark seeks the same exact balance for an odd integer with a certified factorization.
visualization.captionZh: 6 是偶完全数；评测要求奇整数在附带认证分解时达到同样的精确平衡。

statement.intro: A positive integer is perfect when its divisor sum satisfies
statement.introZh: 若正整数的约数和满足下式，则称为完全数：
statement.explanation: Euclid and Euler characterize all even perfect numbers. The unresolved question asks whether any odd $N$ satisfies the same identity.
statement.explanationZh: Euclid 与 Euler 已刻画所有偶完全数；未决问题是是否存在满足同一恒等式的奇数 $N$。
statement.note: A candidate is accepted only when its complete prime-power factorization is certified and the multiplicative divisor-sum formula equals $2N$ exactly.
statement.noteZh: 候选仅在完整素数幂分解得到认证，且乘法约数和公式精确等于 $2N$ 时通过。

atlas.title: An ancient question narrowed by computation and structure
atlas.titleZh: 由计算与结构不断收窄的古老问题
atlas.body: Research has not found a witness, but it has forced every hypothetical odd perfect number to be enormous and highly structured.
atlas.bodyZh: 研究尚未找到实例，但已证明任何可能的奇完全数都必须极其巨大且具有严格结构。

events.title: Euclid constructs even perfect numbers
events.description: Euclid links Mersenne primes to even perfect numbers; Euler later proves the converse.
events.descriptionZh: Euclid 将 Mersenne 素数与偶完全数联系起来，Euler 后来证明其逆命题。

events.title: Euler constrains the odd case
events.description: Any odd perfect number must have the form $q^{4k+1}m^2$ with $q\equiv1\pmod4$.
events.descriptionZh: 任意奇完全数必须形如 $q^{4k+1}m^2$，且 $q\equiv1\pmod4$。

events.title: The computational lower bound passes $10^{1500}$
events.description: Ochem and Rao eliminate all smaller candidates through a reproducible factor-chain search.
events.descriptionZh: Ochem 与 Rao 通过可复现的因子链搜索排除全部更小候选。

events.title: At least ten distinct prime factors are required
events.titleZh: 至少需要十个不同素因子
events.description: Nielsen strengthens the factor-count restriction for every hypothetical odd perfect number.
events.descriptionZh: Nielsen 加强了任意潜在奇完全数的不同素因子数量限制。

events.title: Certified branch-search artifacts extend the computational program
events.titleZh: 认证分支搜索继续推进计算计划
events.description: Recent work packages selected smallest-prime branches as verifier-checkable certificates while leaving the global existence question open.
events.descriptionZh: 近期工作将若干最小素因子分支整理为可由验证器检查的证书，但整体存在性问题仍开放。

frontier.title: A hypothetical integer under severe constraints
frontier.titleZh: 受严苛约束的假想整数
frontier.summary: Existence remains open, but a candidate can no longer be small or structurally simple. It must combine Euler's special-prime form with an enormous lower bound and a rich factorization, while balancing its divisor sum exactly.
frontier.summaryZh: 存在性仍未解决，但候选已不可能很小或结构简单。它必须同时满足 Euler 特殊素因子形式、极大的数值下界与复杂分解，并让约数和精确平衡。

facts.label: LOWER BOUND
facts.text: Every hypothetical odd perfect number must exceed $10^{1500}$, far beyond direct enumeration of individual integers.
facts.textZh: 任何假想奇完全数都必须超过 $10^{1500}$，远超逐个枚举整数所能覆盖的范围。

facts.label: FACTORIZATION
facts.text: At least ten distinct prime factors are required. A complete certified prime-power factorization makes $\sigma(N)=\prod_i(1+p_i+\cdots+p_i^{e_i})$ exactly checkable.
facts.textZh: 候选至少需要十个不同素因子。完整认证的素数幂分解可使 $\sigma(N)=\prod_i(1+p_i+\cdots+p_i^{e_i})$ 得到精确核验。

benchmark.name: OPBench · Odd Perfect Number Construction
benchmark.title: One open construction, fully certified
benchmark.titleZh: 一道开放构造题，完整认证
benchmark.body: The benchmark asks for one odd perfect number together with the complete factorization certificate needed for an exact offline verdict.
benchmark.bodyZh: 评测要求构造一个奇完全数，并同时提交可供离线程序精确判定的完整分解证书。
benchmark.hintNote: This open problem is evaluated without hints.
benchmark.hintNoteZh: 该开放问题统一采用无提示评测。
benchmark.footer: A prose claim or a large odd number is insufficient: the prime-power list must multiply to $N$, each prime must be certified, and $\sigma(N)=2N$ must hold exactly.
benchmark.footerZh: 仅有文字声明或大奇数并不足够：素数幂列表必须乘得 $N$，每个素数必须认证，且 $\sigma(N)=2N$ 必须精确成立。

tasks.title: Certified Odd Perfect Number
tasks.subtitle: One integer · complete prime-power certificate
tasks.subtitleZh: 一个整数 · 完整素数幂证书
tasks.significance: A passing finite certificate would settle one of the oldest open questions in number theory.
tasks.significanceZh: 通过的有限证书将解决数论中最古老的开放问题之一。
tasks.questionZh: 构造一个奇正整数 $N$ 及其完整、经过素性认证的素数幂分解，并精确满足 $\sigma(N)=2N$。

evaluation.title: Factorization and divisor-sum verdicts
evaluation.body: The dashboard separates parsing, parity, factorization certification, and the final divisor-sum equality.
evaluation.bodyZh: 仪表板分别展示解析、奇偶性、分解认证与最终约数和等式。

references.title: Odd Perfect Numbers Are Greater Than 10^1500
references.description: A reproducible factor-chain computation establishing the landmark lower bound and additional factor restrictions.
references.descriptionZh: 以可复现因子链计算建立里程碑式下界，并给出更多因子限制。

references.title: Odd Perfect Numbers Have at Least Nine Distinct Prime Factors
references.titleZh: 奇完全数至少有九个不同素因子
references.description: A major structural restriction on the prime factorization of any hypothetical odd perfect number.
references.descriptionZh: 对任何假想奇完全数的素因数分解给出重要结构限制。

references.title: Odd Perfect Numbers, Diophantine Equations, and Upper Bounds
references.titleZh: 奇完全数、丢番图方程与上界
references.description: The work deriving that an odd perfect number must have at least ten distinct prime divisors.
references.descriptionZh: 推出奇完全数必须至少具有十个不同素因子的研究。

references.title: Odd Perfect Numbers: programs, proof trees, and open composites
references.titleZh: 奇完全数：程序、证明树与待分解合数
references.authors: Pascal Ochem, Michaël Rao, and contributors
references.description: A specialist project page sharing computational methods, factor data, proof-tree artifacts, and newer search bounds.
references.descriptionZh: 专业项目页面，公开计算方法、因子数据、证明树材料和更新的搜索下界。

references.title: OddPerfect.org
references.description: A long-running community entry point for results, bounds, bibliography, and computational work on odd perfect numbers.
references.descriptionZh: 长期汇总奇完全数相关结果、下界、书目与计算工作的社区入口。

symbolicLab.title: Test a candidate odd perfect number interactively
symbolicLab.titleZh: 交互验证候选奇完全数
symbolicLab.body: Enter N and its complete prime-power factorization. The browser certifies the factors and checks the divisor-sum constraints locally; it does not use an LLM judge or assess novelty.
symbolicLab.bodyZh: 输入 N 及其完整素数幂分解。浏览器在本地认证因子并检查除数和约束；不使用 LLM judge，也不判断创新性。
symbolicLab.outputFormat:
OUTPUT:
{"N": <positive odd integer>, "factors": [{"p": <prime integer>, "e": <positive integer>, "certificate": <null or Pocklington certificate>}]}

SOLUTION:
<exact derivation and certificate checks>
